stage0081_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$トウジ$$ and $$ケンスケ$$ came
　to $$第３新東京市$$ too, huh?」

stage0081_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「We came to see $$トウジ$$'s sister.
　Then, out of nowhere, we got told
　to evacuate, and $c showed up - what a scramble.」

stage0081_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$正太郎$$
「You seem to be enjoying this, $$ケンスケ$$.」

stage0081_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Well, yeah.
　Getting to film an EVA's supersonic dash
　was insanely lucky.」

stage0081_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It was pretty rough on our end, though.」

stage0081_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$トウジ$$
「For that, you sure seem in a good mood.」

stage0081_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Well, call it a reward for your hard work.
　Here, ice cream's on me.」

stage0081_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Then I've got a right to be treated too.」

stage0081_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Give me back my ice cream!」

stage0081_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What... Just go buy another one.」

stage0081_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Even though you were that broke,
　you still treated us.」

stage0081_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「His sister's getting better, so he's happy
　and feeling generous.」

stage0081_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Shut it!
　You didn't need to say that, idiot!」

stage0081_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Now, now, $$トウジ$$...
　If one of us gets a winner, you can
　have ice cream too.」

stage0081_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$トウジ$$
「So how'd it go, $$ワッ太$$?
　Winner, or a loser?」

stage0081_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「I lost too, and so did Ikari.
　How about Shikinami?」

stage0081_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アスカ$$
「...I lost.
　And Suzuhara went and gave me his, too.」

stage0081_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Whatever, fine.
　It's stupid $$シンジ$$ I had business with.」

stage0081_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Just be at $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ on time.
　That's all.」

stage0081_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「There's no way I can let this slide.」

stage0081_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Uh... well... I'm... not really
　sure myself, but...」

stage0081_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Well then, we'll explain
　in $$シンジ$$'s place.」

stage0081_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Right now, a cooking boom looks
　set to start in $c.」

stage0081_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$正太郎$$
「It started when $$レイ#333$$ got a miso soup
　recipe from $$アルト$$.」

stage0081_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Don't tell me Shikinami's cooking
　to compete with Ayanami?」

stage0081_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Isn't what they're really competing
　over $$シンジ$$?」

stage0081_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「You... I already envy you just for
　piloting an EVA, and now you're in
　a situation like that! Unforgivable!」

stage0081_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「T-that's not it...!
　It's really not like that, I swear!」

stage0081_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$正太郎$$
「S-$$シンジ$$, you have a checkup at
　NERV Headquarters after this, right!?」

stage0081_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「We're having $$トウジ$$ and the others
　show us around $$第３新東京市$$.
　Be back by dinner, okay?」

stage0081_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「And $$シンジ$$'s in a situation where he
　gets to taste two cute girls' cooking...」

stage0081_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Playing tour guide for grade schoolers is
　pretty pathetic, honestly... At least
　Boss $$ゼシカ$$ or Boss $$ＭＩＸ$$ would be a thrill...」

stage0081_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「No grumbling, no grumbling.
　Come on, let's go!」

stage0081_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Well then, $$シンジ$$... see you later.」

stage0081_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Ayanami and $$アスカ$$, having a cooking
　contest... for my sake...）

stage0081_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$マリ$$
「Oop, sorry sorry!
　But you're also at fault for standing
　around in the road, y'know.」

stage0081_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$マリ$$
「Let's call it even and forgive each other!」

stage0081_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...I think walking while on the phone
　is the problem, though...」

stage0081_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$シンジ$$
「How did she know I'm with NERV...」

stage0081_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$アスカ$$
（In a fight, I can't afford to pick
　my methods... I have to raise my
　cooking skill, no matter what...）

stage0081_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$アスカ$$
（...Fight... who exactly am I
　fighting...? Stupid $$シンジ$$'s cooking...
　or...?）

stage0081_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$アスカ$$
（Argh! This isn't the time to think
　about that! Results, that's all
　that matters!）

stage0081_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アルト$$
「W-what...
　Isn't this the first time you've
　called me senior?」

stage0081_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Shut up!
　I'm swallowing my pride to ask
　you a favor!」

stage0081_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's not it.
　...But you'd better be prepared.」

stage0081_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Who do you think you're talking to.
　This $$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$...
　I won't cave from just anything.」

stage0081_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$アルト$$
「Got it.
　Let's head to the salon, then.」

stage0081_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$アルト$$
「Good timing.
　To be fair, I'll handle the two
　of you together.」

stage0081_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's not it, $$レイ#333$$.
　Don't slam the knife down, cut with
　a pushing motion.」

stage0081_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$甲児$$
「Good, that's the spirit.
　...Have you tried making
　$$アルト$$'s miso soup?」

stage0081_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's $$アルト$$'s flavor, through and
　through. Try all kinds of things
　and find your own.」

stage0081_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$アルト$$'ll be here soon.
　Once he is, the real training begins.」

stage0081_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$スズネ$$
「You're finally starting to look
　the part, $$レイ#333$$. Your knife
　work too.」

stage0081_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$n
「If Unit-00 had a knife equipped,
　I don't think we'd have struggled
　this much, but...」

stage0081_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But it's nice, isn't it?
　Seeing a girl cook.」

stage0081_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「You're so old-fashioned, $$アマタ$$.
　'Cooking means girls' is an idea
　from twelve thousand years ago.」

stage0081_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（Hmm... So $$アマタ$$ likes that
　type of girl too...）

stage0081_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$甲児$$
「Been waiting, $$アルト$$.
　$$レイ#333$$'s training's already
　underway.」

stage0081_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Good opportunity.
　Let's settle this between you
　and me, through this training.」

stage0081_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$不動$$
「Once I hear the word training,
　I can't stay quiet.」

stage0081_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Supreme Commander $$不動$$!
　Since when!?」

stage0081_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$不動$$
「Since when...
　If you ask that, I'll answer
　like this.」

stage0081_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$モロイ$$
「I don't really get what that
　means, but it's incredibly
　intense...!」

stage0081_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$不動$$
「Now then, $$綾波レイ$$,
　$$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$...」

stage0081_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$不動$$
「Do you know the difference between feed and a meal?」

stage0081_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$不動$$
「The cook pours their feelings into the food,
　and the one who eats receives them in turn.」

stage0081_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$不動$$
「In other words, cooking exists to be eaten...
　A dish nobody eats is the height of folly.」

stage0081_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What are you trying to say?」

stage0081_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Just spit it out already!
　We can't spare even a second here!」

stage0081_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$不動$$
「Then I shall say it!
　I declare the 1st $c Cooking Contest open!」

stage0081_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$不動$$
「The contestants are $$綾波レイ$$,
　$$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$, $$ミコノ・スズシロ$$,
　and $$ゼシカ・ウォン$$, four in total!」

stage0081_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Ladies and gentlemen, thank you all for
　coming. Sorry to keep you waiting.」

stage0081_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's showtime!
　I hereby declare the opening
　of the 1st $c Cooking Contest!」

stage0081_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm $$ロジャー・スミス$$, and I'll be your host.」

stage0081_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「And I'm your assistant, $$Ｒ．ドロシー・ウェインライト$$...」

stage0081_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「This cooking contest has a long history,
　if my memory serves correctly...」

stage0081_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「That's rich, coming from someone with no memory.」

stage0081_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$桂$$
「Skip the speeches, let's get started.
　The food's gonna go cold.」

stage0081_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Right, let's get back on track.
　The four contestants will cook the dish
　Supreme Commander $$不動$$ assigned, for tasting.」

stage0081_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The judges will tally the results,
　deciding the winner of this contest.」

stage0081_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now, let's introduce the judges.」

stage0081_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「First, peerless in Japanese cuisine:
　Jindai High Volunteer Club head, $$早乙女アルト$$!」

stage0081_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$アルト$$
「...How did I end up with a role like this...?」

stage0081_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Come on, you gotta enjoy stuff like this.」

stage0081_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Next judge...
　The key to this contest is 'love'...
　Which means it has to be this person...!」

stage0081_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The time-crossing ladies' man, $$桂木桂$$!」

stage0081_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$桂$$
「Girls' home cooking? I've got that covered.」

stage0081_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Next, Living Squad's cooking rep, $$谷川風花$$!」

stage0081_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$谷川$$
「Anyone who serves an inedible dish,
　I'll retrain from scratch in the Squad!」

stage0081_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「And serving as head judge, Takeo General
　Company's Managing Director, $$厚井鉄男$$!」

stage0081_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$厚井$$
「Why'd I end up as head judge...」

stage0081_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$郁絵$$
「Well, the Director does have a sharp palate.」

stage0081_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$木下$$
「That's right.
　Plus, he's famous for expressing a dish's
　flavor with his entire body.」

stage0081_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now, let's move to the judging.
　And here, for the first time, we'll reveal
　the challenge from Supreme Commander $$不動$$.」

stage0081_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Japanese? Chinese? Or French, Italian?」

stage0081_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A dish with a hole in it!」

stage0081_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「What in the world is that...」

stage0081_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Is that...even a genre of food...?」

stage0081_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$不動$$
「Now then... how will they cook their own feelings...?」

stage0081_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now, entry number one.
　$$ミコノ・スズシロ$$!」

stage0081_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's a pretzel.
　I made it sweet instead of salty,
　so it can be eaten as a snack.」

stage0081_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Also, since I didn't need to worry about
　keeping it fresh, I baked it soft, not hard.」

stage0081_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$シュレード$$
「I see... Tying it in a heart shape
　suits $$ミコノ$$, the one who connects us.」

stage0081_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「And it's so sweet, too!
　That's so $$ミコノ$$...if you know what I mean.」

stage0081_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$アマタ$$...!
　Don't scarf it all down by yourself!」

stage0081_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$タケル$$
「You're going at it pretty hard too, $$カイエン$$.」

stage0081_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$カイエン$$
「That's...if no one ate $$ミコノ$$'s dish...」

stage0081_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I understand...!
　I know exactly how you feel!」

stage0081_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ルカ$$
「That's just like you, Captain $$オズマ$$,
　buying up all of $$ランカ$$'s debut discs.」

stage0081_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$シュレード$$
「You worry too much about $$ミコノ$$, buddy.」

stage0081_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Quit talking nonsense and eat already!」

stage0081_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Next up, entry number two!
　$$ゼシカ・ウォン$$!」

stage0081_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I...haven't really done much cooking...
　So...um...I can only make simple stuff...」

stage0081_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Fresh out of the fryer, this is the best!」

stage0081_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Nah～!
　Sauce goes better with it!」

stage0081_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ジョニー$$
（But it is a little concerning.）

stage0081_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$エイーダ$$
（Are those teary eyes from the onions?
　Or is it...）

stage0081_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Next, entry number three!
　$$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$!」

stage0081_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$クラン$$
「$$アスカ$$'s doing onion rings too...!?」

stage0081_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ルカ$$
「No, that's not it...!
　This is...」

stage0081_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$アスカ$$
「That's right...
　They're fried calamari rings.」

stage0081_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Now this makes me want a beer!」

stage0081_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's right...
　It's $$シンジ$$-chan's specialty, the one he
　makes me to go with my beer.」

stage0081_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$n
「I see...
　So $$アスカ$$'s a fan of it too, huh.」

stage0081_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Hey, you!
　Quit running your mouth and eat already!」

stage0081_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「And now, the final entry, number four!
　$$綾波レイ$$!」

stage0081_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ボス$$
「You just cut it up and laid it out!」

stage0081_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$柿小路$$
「What are you talking about.
　Sliced kamaboko is a dish, itawasa!」

stage0081_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$赤木$$
「It's good with wasabi and soy sauce.」

stage0081_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「With that, every dish is on the table.
　Judges, if you would...your verdict.」

stage0081_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$アルト$$
「What should we do?
　They're all decent, but...」

stage0081_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$谷川$$
「Well, let's set the chikuwa one aside...」

stage0081_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$桂$$
「So it's down to the other three...」

stage0081_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$谷川$$
「But then, no one's going to accept that...」

stage0081_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$厚井$$
「No...!
　Saying anyone won or lost over dishes
　like these would be presumptuous!」

stage0081_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$厚井$$
「Your pretzel's flavor was gentle and sweet,
　but put another way, it was indecisive
　and half-baked.」

stage0081_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$厚井$$
「You should express your own will clearly,
　and commit firmly to a flavor, not waver.」

stage0081_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$厚井$$
「This onion ring shows exactly your
　timidity, your lack of confidence」

stage0081_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$厚井$$
「Oil temperature, fry time, seasoning...
　Each one's a little off, so the crisp
　texture it should have has gone soggy」

stage0081_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$厚井$$
「Such good squid, but the batter's
　too thick. Vanity, trying too hard
　to impress, or no confidence?」

stage0081_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$厚井$$
「Show more of what's really there.
　As it is, your true flavor is
　hidden behind needless caution」

stage0081_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$厚井$$
「But if you'd filled that hole with
　cucumber or cheese, it'd have been
　better」

stage0081_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$厚井$$
「What you put in there is what matters」

stage0081_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$木下$$
「As expected of the Managing Director!
　You're inhuman when it comes to flavor!」

stage0081_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Well, Managing Director $$厚井$$'s
　ruling was a draw. Supreme Commander
　$$不動$$, any comments?」

stage0081_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$不動$$
「No... a fair judgment. You have my
　compliments」

stage0081_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$アルト$$
「A draw, huh...
　Well, guess that's a peaceful enough
　result」

stage0081_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$桂$$
「But this'll probably leave some bad
　blood. Especially over there...」

stage0081_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I at least wanted to beat $$ミコノ$$
　at cooking」

stage0081_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It was a draw, after all.
　We should both try harder next time」

stage0081_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「No... between me and $$ミコノ$$, she
　wins after all. $$アマタ$$ looked like
　he enjoyed hers more, too...」

stage0081_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「...Stop it.
　Being comforted just makes me feel
　more pathetic...」

stage0081_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$カイエン$$
「The cook-off is over!
　Let's move out, everyone!」

stage0081_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（After all, fighting is all I have...!）

stage0081_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Everyone's busy with maintenance
　after getting back, and you're just
　going to head off on your own?」

stage0081_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$アスカ$$
「That's surprising.
　I thought EVA came first for you...」

stage0081_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Isn't that true of you too?」

stage0081_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「...EVA is a mirror of one's own heart」

stage0081_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「You don't need to rely on EVA.
　You have a happiness that doesn't need it」

stage0081_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Don't act so high-and-mighty!
　You're just the Teacher's Pet!」

stage0081_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$アスカ$$
「It's because I'm a genius that
　I was chosen as a pilot on my own merit.
　I'm not like you lot who got in through connections!」

stage0081_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「I'm only ever connected.
　It's only through EVA that I can connect with anyone」

stage0081_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Shut up!
　You're just his prim little doll who does
　whatever Commander Ikari says, that's all!?」

stage0081_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$アスカ$$
「You are a doll!
　Know yourself for once!」

stage0081_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I'll ask you one thing.
　What do you think of that idiot?」

stage0081_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「When I say idiot, I mean Idiot $$シンジ$$.
　...Though there's no shortage of idiots...」

stage0081_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$アスカ$$
「This is why dolls are...!
　Just spit it out already!」

stage0081_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「I don't know... But I feel warm inside
　whenever I'm with Ikari. I want him to feel it too」

stage0081_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「I think... I want him to get closer to
　Commander Ikari and feel that warmth too」

stage0081_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Seriously!
　You're such an ultra-idiot!
　That just means you like him, doesn't it?!」

stage0081_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$谷川$$
「Tonight's dinner isn't from the
　auto-cook system, it's completely
　handmade」

stage0081_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$大山$$
「It's a labor of love from the Life
　Support Team and some volunteers.
　Eat it with gratitude」

stage0081_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$厚井$$
「How is it, $$シンジ$$? Was there
　a dish you liked?」

stage0081_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$シンジ$$
「These fried squid rings... the batter's
　thin, so they're really good」

stage0081_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$厚井$$
「The ingredient's flavor comes through
　honestly, doesn't it?」

stage0081_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$正太郎$$
「This chikuwa... has all sorts of
　things stuffed inside」

stage0081_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You're right!
　Cucumber, cheese, ground meat, tuna...
　even curry and red bean paste!」

stage0081_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シンジ$$, try the miso soup too」

stage0081_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...I don't know...
　I can't put it into words, but it
　tastes comforting」

stage0081_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I'll let today end in a draw」

stage0081_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$アスカ$$
「But I'm not losing next time」

stage0081_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$n
「Come to think of it, where's $$ミサト$$?」

stage0081_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$スズネ$$
「She said she's eating out today」

stage0081_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Aah... I do envy $$ミサト$$ sometimes...」

stage0081_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...What is it, this 'important talk'?
　I cancelled a fun dinner party to be
　here」

stage0081_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$加持$$
「Drinking one-on-one with me isn't fun?」

stage0081_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Skip the lame jokes and just tell me
　already」

stage0081_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$加持$$
「Harsh. Doesn't sound like I can bring
　up getting back together after this」

stage0081_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Don't tell me... this 'important talk'
　isn't about that, is it?」

stage0081_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$加持$$
「It's plenty important to me, though」

stage0081_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...I just want to forget the past...」

stage0081_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$加持$$
「I doubt it'll live up to your expectations,
　but narrowing down the membership is coming along」

stage0081_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$加持$$
「Seems Chrono's members are
　basically hereditary, from what I can tell」

stage0081_03:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Hereditary...?
　Does it have that long a history?」

stage0081_03:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$加持$$
「Apparently, the fact NERV could be reborn
　in this world was partly their doing too」

stage0081_03:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Then Commander Ikari, and that group
　rumored to be above us, $$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$...
　they're in contact with Chrono...」

stage0081_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$加持$$
「That's a real possibility.
　How much they know about EVA and
　the Angels, though, is unclear...」

stage0081_03:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$加持$$
「I'll keep investigating the Human Instrumentality
　Project too, said to be NERV's true purpose」

stage0081_03:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$ミサト$$
「What are Commander Ikari and the others
　up to behind the scenes...」

stage0081_03:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$加持$$
「That's enough of this talk.
　Let's enjoy some grown-up time now」

stage0081_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I'm not in the mood for that...」

stage0081_03:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$加持$$
「Maybe it's time you graduated from
　playing guardian. I hear those kids
　have a good vibe going lately」

stage0081_03:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$-chan, $$レイ#333$$, and $$アスカ$$ are all changing...
　Even carrying such a heavy burden, they're not letting it beat them...」

stage0081_03:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$加持$$
「...It's too heavy a burden for kids.
　But we have no choice but to rely on them」

stage0081_03:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$ミサト$$
「But I intend to fulfill at least
　the bare minimum of responsibility」

stage0081_03:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I'm going to put the doubts I've been
　feeling to Commander Ikari directly」

stage0081_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$ミサト$$
「There's no time left...
　And I don't want to have any regrets either」

stage0081_03:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「This is good, $$ミコノ$$'s pretzel...
　Sweet and soft」

stage0081_03:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$ゼシカ$$'s onion rings are good too.
　Fried up nice and crispy」

stage0081_03:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「...Yeah, you're right.
　I guess I lost sight of myself a little...」

stage0081_03:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$ゼシカ$$... I wonder if she's recovered?」

stage0081_03:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$不動$$
「Who knows...
　She still has a wall left to overcome」

stage0081_03:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, thanks to Master $$ミコノ$$ and Master
　$$ゼシカ$$'s efforts in today's battle,
　100Z worth of Z-Chips were born」

stage0081_03:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add these to the squad's stock,
　but personally, I think those two
　could shine even brighter」

stage0081_03:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$不動$$
「Hits and misses...
　Such things mean nothing at all」

stage0081_03:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes.
　Looking at Master $$アマタ$$, I can see why」

stage0081_03:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$不動$$
「Is it $$アマタ・ソラ$$ you're watching?
　Or is it...」

stage0081_03:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$不動$$
「Heh... you're a hard one to read」

stage0081_03:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$加持$$
「Yo... mind if I intrude a bit」

stage0081_03:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$加持$$
「Knowing even my name...
　Your info network beats the rumors,
　dimensional trader」

stage0081_03:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, no, no...
　I'm no match for NERV's Chief Inspector」

stage0081_03:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「More than that, knowing your relationship
　with Master $$ミサト$$, I can't help
　but feel respect for you」

stage0081_03:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$加持$$
「I came to feel the air Katsuragi breathes...
　Or does that sound too slick?」

stage0081_03:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$加持$$
「Well, that's fine.
　$$シンジ$$ and $c need to keep
　watching over Katsuragi, after all」

stage0081_03:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$加持$$
「Because I can't do it anymore」

stage0081_03:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$加持$$
「...Oops, got a little sentimental there.
　Let's change the mood a bit」

stage0081_03:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$加持$$
「Well then, let's get fired up today too!」

stage0081_03:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... having it reversed like this
　feels kind of refreshing...」

stage0081_03:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$加持$$
「Good to hear.
　...Well then, look after Katsuragi」
